'''Holdout [[Flightknife]]''' was a unit of [[Adumar/Legends|Adumari]] [[Blade series]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. Supporting [[General/Legends|General]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], and the [[Running Crimson Flightknife|Running Crimson Flightknives]], they led the assault on [[Cartann]] during the [[Adumari Civil War]]. The Holdout Flightknives landed in [[Cartann City]] and recovered [[Red Flight]], with the assistance of [[Cheriss ke Hanadi]].
